body: Commits e3aaff8/bb1607e on main. Extended the S170-97 keybind table with B (shop toggle), 1-9 (quick-buy), held-TAB (scoreboard), H (ability overlay), and the W-toggle-vs-instant mana distinction. Added a 'Flow, XP, and the item shop' section covering economy sources, character pane, shop positioning/team restriction, and the auto-equip/auto-sell/no-bag model. Noted 7v7 team size. This closes out S170-175's full sprint plan plus the mid-Sprint-4 founder direction (S170-176-179).
